name: courtlistener
description: Search CourtListener opinions and RECAP dockets, download public court materials, and reuse a persistent local research library.
long_description:
Connects Claude to CourtListener, the free public database of American court opinions and PACER filings maintained by the Free Law Project. Opinions and PDFs are saved to a persistent research library folder on this computer so they can be reused across conversations.

Requires a free CourtListener API key. Create or view yours at https://www.courtlistener.com/profile/api-token/

api_key.title: CourtListener API Key
api_key.description: Your free CourtListener API token. Get one at https://www.courtlistener.com/profile/api-token/ — it is stored in your operating system's keychain, not in your conversations.

library_dir.title: CourtListener Library Folder
library_dir.description: Where downloaded opinions and court PDFs are saved. Reserve this folder for material downloaded from CourtListener.
